rule: PRE-REGISTERED: whole-dev-period MEDIAN of row-wise R_t=sigma3m_t/sigma1m_t, frozen in spec.yaml before this script ran; per-year/percentile spread is disclosed context only, not grounds to pick a different R.
note_join_method: inner join on exact bar-close timestamp; 3m bars are ceil('3min') and 1m bars are the raw 1-minute clock, both 18:00-ET-anchored, so every 3m bar's close timestamp is a member of the 1m timestamp set except isolated thin-liquidity gap minutes (matches SMV2U's own MTF-read join-rate finding of ~99.96%).
